name: The Muscle Bunny Girls Caught Me Cheatin'!!!
source:
You play as Robert Liebart, one of the best con-men in the business. You're part of a team of experts organizing a heist at the strip's wealthiest casino : The Lucky Bunny.

The thing is, the Lucky Bunny only hires muscle girls as their hostesses and security personnel. Meet the seductive and determined Jazmine,  as well as her friend the carefree and cute Hannah, as you try to make your way to the casino vault, where riches await. The plan is perfect, you are persuaded nothing can go wrong. Surely you can handle a pair of those beautiful bunnies with biceps, right?

Take a chance and navigate through multiple choices and several action mini-games as you and your heist companion Johnson attempt to leave the casino unscathed. Play your cards right and you might even spend an unforgivable night with one of these muscle bunnies. How much are you willing to bet that you can make it out in one piece?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演罗伯特·利巴特，业内最优秀的骗子之一。你是专家团队的一员，在该地带最富有的赌场“幸运兔”组织抢劫。

问题是，幸运兔只雇用肌肉女孩作为他们的女主人和保安人员。当你试图前往赌场金库时，会遇到迷人而坚定的贾兹敏，以及她的朋友无忧无虑、可爱的汉娜，那里有财富等待着你。计划是完美的，你确信不会出错。你肯定能驾驭一对拥有二头肌的漂亮兔子，对吧？

当你和你的抢劫伙伴约翰逊试图毫发无伤地离开赌场时，抓住机会，浏览多种选择和几个动作迷你游戏。如果你的牌打对了，你甚至可能会和这些肌肉兔子一起度过一个不可原谅的夜晚。你愿意打赌多少钱才能把它完整地完成？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604760/]Steam[/url]]
